main.description: The tracks and artists the directory's DJs supported most in sets played in a time and place, counted the way 1001Tracklists counts its Top 101 Producers: a DJ (a project, however many accounts manage it) supports a track once however often they play it, a track charts once 3 DJs support it, and an artist gets at most 5 supports from one DJ, counting only tracks that chart. Also lists every city there are sets from.

since.description: The first day counted, as YYYY-MM-DD. Without it, every set before `before`.

before.description: The day after the last one counted, as YYYY-MM-DD. Without it, every set from `since` on.

city.description: Only sets played in this city (the set's location.locality, any case). Needs country.

country.description: The city's country, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

limit.description: The most tracks, and the most artists.

tracks.description: Most supported first, then most recently played.

places.description: Cities with sets, by how many, whatever the other params say.
